noise_and_randomization._comment: Mirrors test_sim: wrapper-level DR stacks on top of HeatExchangerTower._sample_episode_dynamics (which randomizes tau/heat_gain/rangeability/dead by +/-10%). These knobs add output gain/bias drift, input jitter, and DV mean shift on the outside of the plant. Each value is a magnitude; the randomizer draws per-episode within +/- value. Disable via DREAMER_SIM_DOMAIN_RANDOMIZATION=0. Leftover SIM_DOMAIN_RANDOMIZATION / DREAMER_DOMAIN_RANDOMIZATION are ignored.
